The Open Door Notes (1899 and 1900) were US diplomatic letters from Secretary of State John Hay. They asked the great powers to keep China open to equal trade access and to respect its territorial and administrative integrity. Of the two options you listed, the first (China open to US trade) is the closer fit, though "proclamation" and "missionaries" are imprecise. The immigration option is wrong, because the notes had nothing to do with Chinese immigration.

CONFIDENCE: 90
